# Archive Report: fix-slugify-diacritics

## Summary
- Change: fix-slugify-diacritics
- Intent: slugify('Crème Brûlée') returned 'crème-brûlée'; should be 'creme-brulee'. Root cause: regex /[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu kept accented letters, no normalization.
- Completed: 2026-10-23
- Verdict: PASS WITH WARNINGS (auto-approved, unattended)

## Artifact Lineage
| Phase | Artifact | Topic Key |
|---|---|---|
| Explore | Exploration analysis | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/explore |
| Explore | Brainstorm (Approach A chosen) | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/brainstorm |
| Propose | Proposal | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/proposal |
| Spec | Delta spec | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/spec |
| Design | Technical design | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/design |
| Plan | Task plan | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/plan |
| Apply | Apply progress | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/apply-progress |
| Verify | Verify report | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/verify-report |
| Archive | This report | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/archive-report |
| State | DAG state | flow/fix-slugify-diacritics/state |

## Spec Integration Summary
### Added Requirements
- REQ-001: transliterate Latin letters with decomposable diacritics to base ASCII (4 scenarios)
- REQ-002: NFC and NFD inputs yield identical output (3 scenarios)
### Modified Requirements
- REQ-003: ASCII behaviour unchanged (4 scenarios)
- REQ-004: non-decomposable letters (ß, ø) and mark-free non-Latin unchanged (2 scenarios)
- REQ-005: public API and dependencies unchanged; String coercion kept (3 scenarios)
### Removed Requirements
None.

## Architecture Decisions Record
- D1: after trim, NFD -> strip U+0300-036F marks following a Latin-script base -> NFC, before the non-alnum replace. Zero deps.
- D2: do NOT strip all \p{M}; it would corrupt Indic/Thai vowel signs and change Cyrillic й. Scope to Latin bases.
- D3: final NFC recomposes untouched scripts (e.g. Hangul) so non-Latin output is byte-identical to before and NFC/NFD agree.
- D4: toLowerCase stays first; no signature/export change; no new files.
- Rejected: Approach B/C (lookup table or dependency) for ß/ø/æ/ł; deferred as follow-up.

## Warnings and Known Issues
- WARNING: Hangul guard test does not fail under mutation (NFC recomposes); regression-only value, accepted.
- OBSERVATION: decomposed Cyrillic input (и + U+0306) now yields 'й' after NFC (previously 'и'); benign canonicalization, not pinned by a test.
- REQ-005 S2 (deps unchanged) has no automated test; verified via git diff.
- Changes remain UNCOMMITTED in working tree (src/slugify.js, test/slugify.test.js) per orchestrator instruction.
- Follow-ups: ß/ø/æ/ł transliteration (Approach B); optional README note skipped.

## Statistics
- Tasks completed: 6/6
- Spec scenarios covered: 16/16 (REQ-005 S2 by git diff, non-runtime)
- Tests added: 15 (slugify 3 -> 18; full suite 24/24 pass)
- Files changed: 2 (src/slugify.js, test/slugify.test.js; 74 insertions)

## Cleanup Recommendations (not executed)
No worktrees or branches were created; work is on main, uncommitted. Human should review and commit the 2 files when ready.
